FIX #1 (company scoping in reports) — VERIFIED: _buildAnnualReport (v2.html:2759) uses activeKey=currentCompany||'trafic'; _buildYearComparison (v2.html:2898) same pattern. openAnnualReport/openYearComparison both call the correct helper with no cross-company mixing. Cannot regression-test cross-company mixing without seed data, but code path is correct.

The v2.0.65 string is in the *changelog list*, not in the version pill — this is expected: changelog entries are historical, version pill is current.
